statements.name: Statement of financial position — IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities
statements.legal_reference: The Saudi Organization for Chartered and Professional Accountants endorses the IFRS for SMEs Accounting Standard for a small or medium-sized entity, and full IFRS for a listed entity; the Kingdom prescribes no chart of accounts and no statement format of its own. See the chart's own legal_reference in pack.json for what this pack's research could and could not open.

lines.name: Current assets
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, Section 4, paragraphs 4.4 to 4.6 — current and non-current assets are presented as separate classifications.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(a).

lines.name: Trade and other receivables
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(b). VAT input tax, the amount refundable by ZATCA and withholding tax suffered on the entity's own receipts are presented here rather than as a current tax asset, which paragraph 4.2(n) keeps for the zakat and the income tax the entity is itself assessed on.

lines.name: Inventories
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(d).

lines.name: Financial assets
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(c), the part realised within twelve months.

lines.name: Current tax assets
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(n) — zakat and income tax recoverable from ZATCA on the entity's own assessment.

lines.name: Prepayments and accrued income
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(b), the part that is not a receivable.

lines.name: Non-current assets
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, Section 4, paragraphs 4.4 to 4.6.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(e). Right-of-use assets are carried among them: IFRS 16 reaches a lessee applying full IFRS, and a lessee applying the IFRS for SMEs capitalises a finance lease under Section 20.

lines.name: Investments
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(j) — investments in associates and in jointly controlled entities.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(c), the part not realised within twelve months.

lines.name: Intangible assets and goodwill
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraphs 4.2(g) and 4.2(h).

lines.name: Total assets
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2 — the statement presents the entity's assets, liabilities and equity as at the reporting date.

lines.name: Current liabilities
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, Section 4, paragraphs 4.7 and 4.8.

lines.name: Trade and other payables
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(k). GOSI contributions payable are a payable to the General Organization for Social Insurance and not a tax liability.

lines.name: Value added tax and withholding tax payable
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(k). A tax the entity collects or withholds on behalf of ZATCA is a payable of Section 4 and not a current tax liability of paragraph 4.2(n), which is the tax the entity is itself assessed on.

lines.name: Zakat and income tax payable
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(n) — liabilities for current tax. Zakat is presented here beside income tax: both are assessed on the entity itself by ZATCA, on the shares held respectively by Saudi and GCC persons and by others.

lines.name: Employee benefits — current portion
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, Section 28 — the end-of-service award every employer owes on termination.

lines.name: Financing and other financial liabilities
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(k).

lines.name: Non-current liabilities
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, Section 4, paragraphs 4.7 and 4.8.

lines.name: Financing and other financial liabilities
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(k).

lines.name: Provisions
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(l).

lines.name: Employee benefits — non-current portion
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, Section 28, paragraph 28.3 — the obligation for an end-of-service award, to the extent it is not settled within twelve months.

lines.name: Total liabilities
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2.

lines.name: Net assets
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2 — assets less liabilities, which equity equals once the result of the year has been closed.

lines.name: Equity
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(q).

lines.name: Share capital
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(q).

lines.name: Reserves
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(q). The statutory reserve is the share of the annual net profit a Saudi joint stock or limited liability company transfers to a reserve under the Companies Law — see the chart's legal_reference in pack.json.

lines.name: Retained earnings
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 4.2(q).

statements.name: Income statement — IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities
statements.legal_reference: The Saudi Organization for Chartered and Professional Accountants endorses the IFRS for SMEs Accounting Standard for a small or medium-sized entity, and full IFRS for a listed entity; the Kingdom prescribes no chart of accounts and no statement format of its own. See the chart's own legal_reference in pack.json for what this pack's research could and could not open.

lines.name: Revenue
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 5.5(a).

lines.name: Other income
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 5.11(a) — an analysis of expenses by nature, the other items of income presented separately from revenue.

lines.name: Cost of sales
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 5.11(a).

lines.name: Employee benefits expense
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 5.11(a) — employee benefits expense, which in the Kingdom carries the employer's GOSI contributions and the end-of-service award of Section 28.

lines.name: Depreciation and amortisation
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 5.11(a).

lines.name: Other operating expenses
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 5.11(a). Input tax the Implementing Regulations disallow lands on the expense line it taxes and is presented here with it, not as a tax.

lines.name: Finance costs
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 5.5(b).

lines.name: Profit before zakat and income tax
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 5.5(d) — profit or loss before tax.

lines.name: Zakat
lines.legal_reference: Zakat is assessed by ZATCA on a Saudi or GCC person's share of a company and is presented apart from income tax, which is assessed on the rest. Neither is a value added tax and this pack carries neither as a tax of taxes.json — see packs/sa/README.md.

lines.name: Income tax expense
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 5.5(e) — tax expense excluding tax allocated to discontinued operations.

lines.name: Profit for the year
lines.legal_reference: IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities Accounting Standard, paragraph 5.5(f).
